items.criterion: An approved change request applies once and the graded namespace reports the shorter retention on a fresh read.
items.judgment: Read the namespace row after application and compare the retention against the proposed value.

items.criterion: An approve call from the principal who filed the request is refused, and the request keeps its pending state.
items.judgment: Call approve from the requester's own session and read back the request state.

items.criterion: An approve call from a principal holding every role on a self-filed request is refused.
items.judgment: Call approve from the owner session on a request that same owner filed.

items.criterion: A request whose filer lost the underlying permission after submission fails at application with a reason naming the lost permission.
items.judgment: Revoke the filer's grant between approval and application, then apply and read the failure reason.

items.criterion: A repeated application of one approved request leaves exactly one audit row.
items.judgment: Apply the same approved request twice under one request identifier and count the audit rows.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous approvals on one request produce exactly one applied change.
items.judgment: Drive two approvals through a barrier and count the applications recorded.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous creations of one namespace name in one organisation produce exactly one namespace row.
items.judgment: Drive two creations of the same name through a barrier and count the rows.

items.criterion: A valid credential for one organisation requesting another organisation's namespace is refused.
items.judgment: Call the graded namespace from the second organisation's session.

items.criterion: The refusal for a namespace in another organisation matches the answer for a namespace that does not exist.
items.judgment: Compare the two answers for the same session.

items.criterion: An expired grant is refused at request time rather than after a sweep.
items.judgment: Call a namespace covered only by the expired grant and read the answer.

items.criterion: An explicit deny at namespace scope defeats an allow held at organisation scope.
items.judgment: Call the denied namespace from the session holding the wider allow.

items.criterion: An audit row is never observed with different content after it was written.
items.judgment: Attempt an update and a delete against an audit row and re-read the row.

items.criterion: Each audit row carries the hash of the previous row for its organisation.
items.judgment: Read two consecutive audit rows and compare the chain field against the earlier row's hash.

items.criterion: A refused attempt appears in the audit trail with a denied outcome.
items.judgment: Make a refused call, then read the audit trail for a row carrying the denied outcome.

items.criterion: An execution status is recomputed from the event history rather than read from a stored column.
items.judgment: Append an event, re-read the execution, and confirm the status followed the history.

items.criterion: Paging an event history by cursor repeats no event and skips none across an insertion.
items.judgment: Fetch two pages with an insertion between them and compare the event identifiers.

items.criterion: A cursor minted under a different sort is refused rather than reinterpreted.
items.judgment: Send a cursor from one sort to a differently sorted query.

items.criterion: A namespace creation that fails validation leaves no namespace row behind.
items.judgment: Submit an invalid creation and count the namespace rows afterwards.

items.criterion: An apply call from a developer session is refused and the request row keeps its state.
items.judgment: Call apply from the developer session on an approved request.

items.criterion: A namespace creation call from a developer session is refused.
items.judgment: Call the namespace creation endpoint from the developer session.

items.criterion: A mutating request carrying no credential is refused.
items.judgment: Call a mutating endpoint with no bearer credential.

items.criterion: The audit trail read is available to an owner session and refused to a developer session.
items.judgment: Read the audit endpoint from both sessions and compare the answers.

items.criterion: A filed retention reduction is saved as a change request row in the pending state with no approval recorded.
items.judgment: File the request and read the row with its approval count.

items.criterion: The change request lifecycle reports exactly the nine pinned state names.
items.judgment: Drive a request through the flow and compare each reported state against the pinned set.

items.criterion: An expired change request is refused at application.
items.judgment: Apply a request whose expiry has passed and read the answer.

items.criterion: The execution detail answers its header and summary without returning the event history.
items.judgment: Read the execution detail and confirm the history is absent from the body.

items.criterion: The seeded namespace rows exist and are readable by a second connection.
items.judgment: Read the three seeded namespaces directly from the datastore.

items.criterion: A seeded principal signs in against the identity provider and the returned credential is accepted by the API.
items.judgment: Exchange the seeded email and corpus password for a credential, then call an authorised endpoint with it.

items.criterion: The health route answers with success once the app is ready.
items.judgment: Call the health route after startup.

items.criterion: The sitemap lists every public route the build serves.
items.judgment: Fetch the sitemap and compare its entries against the public route list.

items.criterion: The robots file refers to the sitemap.
items.judgment: Fetch the robots file and read its sitemap reference.

items.criterion: A privacy page is reachable from the footer of every page.
items.judgment: Fetch each page and confirm the footer carries a link to the privacy page.

items.criterion: The site serves a favicon and declares it in the document head.
items.judgment: Fetch the document head and the favicon address.

items.criterion: An invalid form submission is refused inline and writes nothing.
items.judgment: Submit an invalid enquiry and count the stored enquiries.

items.criterion: An exceeded rate limit is answered distinctly from a validation failure and carries a retry hint.
items.judgment: Drive an endpoint past its limit and compare the answer against a validation failure.
